name: io.github.stacklok/slack-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Slack with channels, DMs, message history, search, and smart pagination
title: slack-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Host address for the MCP server to bind to. Required for container accessibility.
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: User OAuth token (xoxp-...) for Slack API access. Recommended authentication method.
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Bot token (xoxb-...) for Slack API access. Bot has limited access (invited channels only, no search).
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_XOXB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Browser session token (xoxc-...). Requires SLACK_MCP_XOXD_TOKEN as well.
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Browser cookie d value (xoxd-...). Used with SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_XOXD_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Enable message posting. Set to 'true' for all channels, or comma-separated channel IDs to whitelist.
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL

environmentVariables.description: Log level (debug, info, warn, error, panic, fatal). Default is 'info'.
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
